Cinematic close-up portrait, a young woman standing on a grassland at dusk; the frame focuses on her head, shoulders and upper body, with the subject occupying the visual center slightly right of frame. **The low setting sun blasts from behind as strong backlight, rimming her hair and shoulders with a bright golden halo, a few stray strands rendered translucent by the light; her face is softly filled by warm sky bounce light, with natural highlights on the bridge of the nose and cheekbones, shadow transitions smooth with no blocked-up blacks.** She looks up toward the camera with a serene expression; her skin has a healthy honey tone with visible fine peach fuzz. Light beige hair lifted by the breeze, a few strands resting against her cheek.
The background is **completely blurred golden grassland and pink-purple distant mountains**, dissolving into soft golden-orange and pink-purple bokeh that serves only as atmosphere. Occasional foreground grass blades drift across the lens as soft blur streaks.
85mm full-frame portrait lens, f/1.8, extremely shallow depth of field, tack-sharp focus on both eyes with crisp circular catchlights, natural realistic skin texture, Kodak Portra 400 film palette, cinematic color grading, photorealistic, 8K, 16:9 widescreen, subject at the right third with breathing room on the left.
